essence: By wearing that ash, a woman can bring her own man under her control.
A man can likewise make a woman his maidservant by this means, without doubt.
Those to whom one gives something consecrated a thousand times become subject to one's control.
Reciting the mantra one hundred and eight times with barībhartti yields good speech.
One should daily meditate on the deity delighting in rāsa play and recite the mantra one thousand times.
